echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreCompact","additionalContext":"REMINDER: state/current.md is the canonical current state and overrides this summary. Before relying on the summary, re-read that file. If the plan changed or a workout was logged this session and is not yet in current.md, update it now so it survives compaction."}}'

_comment_auto_sync: There is deliberately NO Stop hook here that commits and pushes.
The author's own setup uses one to auto-sync his coach data to a PRIVATE repo.
That is NOT shipped as a default, because a `git add -A && git push` hook combined
with a public remote would publish your training, biometric and health data.
If you want auto-sync, you must (1) confirm your remote is PRIVATE, (2) decide
whether to un-ignore the personal-data paths in .gitignore, and (3) add the hook
yourself. See the 'Optional: auto-sync your data' section in README.md.
Defaults should be safe. This one is.
